description: This file defines a builder class for creating immutable Feature objects within the Eclipse Ditto project. The class provides a fluent API to build features from scratch or from JSON, including setting IDs, definitions, and properties.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureFromScratchBuilder
classes.description: A final class implementing builders for creating Feature objects, supporting JSON and scratch-based creation, with configuration methods for ID, definition, and properties.

methods.name: newFeatureFromJson
methods.description: Static method to create a builder initialized from a JSON object.

methods.name: newFeatureFromScratch
methods.description: Static method to create a new builder for a Feature from scratch.

methods.name: useId
methods.description: Setter for the feature ID, with validation.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Setter for the feature definition, nullable.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Setter for feature properties, accepting both FeatureProperties and JsonObject.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Alias for useId method, following fluent API style.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the final immutable Feature object, considering if the JSON value was null.
